protocol.treatment: Catalog availability: reuse may inspect/copy/adapt or install suitable blocks; scratch uses existing app and ordinary dependencies. No forced checkout/discard ritual.
protocol.sessions: Fresh CLI session for every implementation, maintenance and optional repair; maintenance begins on each arm own persisted app and data.
protocol.repairs: At most one repair per phase after independent verification; same failed-check feedback format. Incomplete integration continues into maintenance and stays labeled incomplete.
protocol.accounting: All attempts included. Missing final billing events remain unknown and halt further paid calls. CLI list-price estimates, not invoice charges. Preparation/orchestration unmetered separately.
protocol.isolation: Sequential; restricted file tools; fixed project commands; no Bash or web. Cooperative code execution, not a hostile-code sandbox.
